title: 24 — Product + Comment Callout (Faux Social Proof)
description: Two-zone layout. Top 55%: clean studio product shot with the cap slightly open or product-in-use detail. Bottom 45%: realistic Facebook-style comment card with profile photo, name, testimonial body, timestamp, and emoji reactions. The comment looks like a genuine screenshot someone dropped below a product photo. Works as social proof when UGC-feel is preferred over studio polish.
